newsitem.title: CANADA: William Resources to raise up to C$36 mln.
newsitem.headline: William Resources to raise up to C$36 mln.

text.p: William Resources Inc said on Tuesday it signed a deal to raise up to C$36 million by selling 16.7 million common shares.
A syndicate led by ScotiaMcLeod will buy the shares for C$1.80 each, for resale to the public, the company said.
The underwriters have the option to purchase for resale up to an additional 3.3 million common shares, William Resources said.
The company said it expected to raise C$30.06 million before the underwriters' option. If the underwriters exercised their option, the company would raise an additional C$5.94 million.
About C$25 million of the proceeds will be used to finance capital expenditures and repay debt from the acquisition of the Jacobina mine in Brazil.
The rest will be used for future acquisitions and general corporate purposes, the company said.
